_comment: Voice-channel device table (docs/voice-channel.md in briefing-table). Static name; hot-reloaded by server.py on change. `device` ids are the roster names the bridge uses. `mode` is the P3 dev-mode flag (chat|development). `room` feeds the origin envelope for location-aware personas later. `announce_url` is the Dot bridge's loopback ingress — never a tailnet URL.
